intro.title: Minuet in G
intro.text: From the notebook Bach gave his wife Anna Magdalena in 1725, now credited to Christian Petzold. A minuet is a dance in 3: lean on beat 1. Both hands play one note at a time.

intro.title: Two sections
intro.text: Bars 1–16 are the A section in G major. Bars 17–32 are the B section: it moves to D major, then comes home to G. Use Practice to loop any bars that trip you up.
